COELOM

  • A coelom is the body cavity present between the body wall and the gut wall, lined by mesoderm.
  • The presence and type of coelom is a key classification axis for animals.

Three Types of Coelom Organisation

#### 1. Acoelomate

  • No coelom — the body cavity is absent; the area between gut and body wall is filled with mesoderm.
  • E.g. Porifera, Coelenterata, Ctenophora, Platyhelminthes.

#### 2. Pseudocoelomate

  • False coelom — body cavity present but not fully lined with mesoderm (only partially lined).
  • E.g. Nematoda / Aschelminthes (roundworms: Ascaris, Wuchereria).

#### 3. Eucoelomate (True Coelomate)

  • True coelom — body cavity fully lined by mesoderm.
  • E.g. Annelida, Mollusca, Echinodermata, Chordata.

Quick Reference

Coelom typePhyla
AcoelomatePorifera, Coelenterata, Ctenophora, Platyhelminthes
PseudocoelomateAschelminthes / Nematoda
EucoelomateAnnelida → Chordata
